comment: Really kind teacher, and especially helpful during office hours. If you want an A you're going to have to put forth effort on the written assignments (like 3 big papers), and I suggest seeing her during office hours. DO READING ASSIGNMENTS- there ARE POP QUIZZES. They are a breeze if you actually read though.

Pop quizzes are very easy and taken from the textbook questions, and she warns the class that day before and grades them leniently. She cares about each student and loves participation in class. It's quite easy to get an A- just show up, speak a little and turn in essays. She's quite lax about deadlines.

She definitely works with each student (if you let her) to make sure they get a good grade. I participated a lot and it was definitely rewarded. Pretty easy grader. Readings are easy but there are one or two that are difficult. Once or twice you may get a pop quiz but they're pretty easy (she will also improve the grade with extra participation).

I'm shy and participation was a huge thing in this class. She was willing to work with me so I could earn these points in other ways. Lots of reading at times which you have to do in order to participate. Easy grader and has clear grading criteria. Class can be boring if you aren't interested. She's super friendly and I would definitely recommend.
